summary: Sinovac Biotech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing an extension of the deadline for shareholders to submit payment instructions for a previously declared special cash dividend of US$55.00 per common share, payable to holders of record as of May 23, 2025. The submission deadline has been extended from December 31, 2025 to June 30, 2026. The dividend represents a significant return of capital to shareholders. The company acts as issuer, distributing cash. Shareholders who have not yet submitted instructions are urged to do so by the new deadline. The extension suggests administrative delays in processing payments. Risk-arbitrage angle: monitor shareholder uptake and any potential litigation or trading disruption related to the dividend mechanics.
